name: Add / Subtract Dates
summary: Add or subtract days, weeks, months, or years from a date — locally in your browser.
description: Pick a start date, choose add or subtract, enter an amount and unit, and get the resulting calendar date. Month and year math clamps end-of-month days safely (for example Jan 31 + 1 month). Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: How are months handled?
faqs.answer: Calendar months are added, then the day is clamped to the last valid day of the target month (Jan 31 + 1 month → Feb 28/29).

faqs.question: Is time of day included?
faqs.answer: No. This tool works on calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) only.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculation runs entirely in your browser.
